听到时笙说喜欢，凤辞立即将火灭了，“这是暹荧花，很难见。”

暹荧花……

没听过。

能让凤辞说难见的，那肯定是很难见，不过也就好看了点，有毛用啊！

暹荧花不是没作用，只是那作用对时笙来说已经不大了，若是还未筑基的弟子，能在这里筑基，百分百能筑基成功，难怪桐山派会把这里列为禁地。

看完花儿，两人顺着原路返回，披着银白月光，两人的身影偶尔重叠，时笙有些晃神。

在她的印象中，似乎没有人这么陪过自己。

时笙面色有一瞬间的冷，眨眼又恢复了那风轻云淡，毫不在乎的模样，目光在前面的人影上打了个转，落在更远的地方，黑暗掩盖住了她眼底的情绪。

在上山的时候，时笙突然拉着凤辞躲到了一簇灌木丛后面，就在她按着凤辞蹲下的瞬间，一道黑乎乎的影子从不远处飞了过去。

今天的月光挺亮的，让时笙看清那个人影是谁。

叶清秋！

大晚上的，她在这里做什么？难不成也是跑出来幽会的？

奇怪，她为什么要用也呢？

不过这种时候，当然是要跟上去围观啊！顺便在做点破坏什么的！

叶清秋的警惕性很高，时笙不敢跟太近，凤辞迷茫的看了一会儿，悟出时笙在做什么，在她和自己身上设了个结界，拉着她大摇大摆的跟在后面。

唉我去，怎么把反派大人忘了！

对于凤辞的结界，时笙还是很有信心的，不然她也不会在那么多人守着的情况下，毫发无损的将归天剑带走。

叶清秋去的地方竟然是他们刚离开的禁地，她那轻车熟路的样子，完全不像是第一次来。

时笙跟着她来到一个山洞。

“放过我……求求你放过我……”求饶声从山洞中传出来。

时笙诧异的挑了挑眉，摸到洞口往里面看，里面光线挺足的，山洞不是很大，一个少女被五花大绑的扔在中间，此时扭着身子，以一个怪异的姿势求饶，而叶清秋则站在一旁，冷眼看着少女。

“要怪就怪你被他选中了。”叶清秋的声音透着一丝厌恶，“你速度快点。”

Hearing Shi Sheng say he liked it, Feng Ci immediately put out the fire, "This is Siam Yinghua, it's hard to see."

Siamese flower…

Never heard of it.

If Feng Ci can say it's hard to see, then it must be hard to see, but it's just a little prettier, so it's useful!

It's not that Siam Yinghua has no effect, but its effect is no longer great for Shi Sheng. If a disciple who has not yet established a foundation can build a foundation here, he will definitely succeed in establishing a foundation. No wonder the Tongshan Sect will list this place as a forbidden area.

After looking at the flowers, the two of them returned along the same path. Under the silvery moonlight, their figures occasionally overlapped, making Shi Sheng feel a little dazed.

In her impression, it seemed that no one had ever accompanied her like this.

Shi Sheng's face turned cold for a moment, then she returned to her calm and unconcerned look in the blink of an eye. Her gaze turned to the figure in front of her and landed farther away. The darkness covered the emotions in her eyes.

While going up the mountain, Shi Sheng suddenly pulled Feng Ci and hid behind a bush. The moment she squatted down with Feng Ci, a dark shadow flew over from not far away.

The moonlight was quite bright today, allowing Shi Sheng to see clearly who the figure was.

Ye Qingqiu!

What is she doing here at night?Could it be that he also ran out for a tryst?

Strange, why would she use it?

But at this time, of course you have to follow and watch!I'm doing some damage or something by the way!

Ye Qingqiu was very vigilant, and Shi Sheng did not dare to follow him too close. Feng Ci looked at him confusedly for a while, then realized what Shi Sheng was doing, and set up a barrier between her and himself, pulling her to follow him swaggeringly.

Oh, let me go, why did I forget the villain?

Shi Sheng was still very confident about Feng Ci's barrier, otherwise she would not have taken away the Death Sword unscathed with so many people guarding it.

The place Ye Qingqiu went to turned out to be the forbidden area they had just left. Her familiar appearance did not look like it was her first time here.

Shi Sheng followed her to a cave.

"Let me go...please let me go..." A voice begging for mercy came from the cave.

Shi Sheng raised his eyebrows in surprise, touched the entrance of the cave and looked inside. There was plenty of light inside, and the cave was not very big. A girl was tied up and thrown in the middle. She was twisting her body and begging for mercy in a weird posture, while Ye Qingqiu stood aside and looked at the girl coldly.

"If you're to blame, it's your fault for being chosen by him." Ye Qingqiu's voice revealed a hint of disgust, "Hurry up."
